set.body: Epic: bd-01KWVZPNECAPJ19KD7HDD8ERRA. Add QC data types and law tests for the spatial core. Acceptance: identity operator behaves as identity, direct affine path matches composed affine path within tolerance, dot(Px,y)=dot(x,P^T y), ROI restriction preserves selected rows, coverage is explicit for invalid samples, and fixtures can be compared against neurofunctor triplets.
set.title: Spatial QC: functor, adjoint, and coverage laws
